# Mushfiqur Rahman Shishir

> While playing the role of CTO at AGT Software Partners, I have been actively involved in full-stack development, bringing over 15 years of experience in delivering impactful solutions across diverse industries.

## Executive Profile & Leadership Roles

- **CTO (Chief Technology Officer)** at [AGT Software Partners](https://allgentech.io/)
  - Leading technology strategy, software architecture, and full-stack engineering delivery across enterprise and client solutions.
- **Co-Founder** at [KMS Marketplace](https://kmsmarketplace.com/)
  - Co-founding and driving product architecture, digital commerce platforms, and scalable marketplace solutions.
- **Co-Founder** at [KMS Tech](https://kmstech.co)
  - Co-founding modern tech ventures, enterprise engineering consultancy, and digital transformation initiatives.
- **Lead Architect** at [Jobayar Abir Peal (mrpeal)](https://www.mrpeal.com/)
  - Directing technical architecture and high-end digital portfolio engineering for award-winning JAP Studios.

## Featured Projects & Ventures

1. **[KMS Marketplace](https://kmsmarketplace.com/)**
   - **Role**: Co-Founder • **Category**: E-Commerce
   - **Description**: An ethical e-commerce marketplace platform rooted in spiritual legacy and social responsibility, curating premium lifestyle and wellness products with seamless checkout.
   - **Tech Stack**: Shopify, Liquid, JavaScript, TailwindCSS

2. **[KMS Tech](https://kmstech.co)**
   - **Role**: Co-Founder • **Category**: Digital Innovation
   - **Description**: Technology innovation company building modern web infrastructure, digital tools, and scalable platforms with sacred intention and uncompromising engineering craft.
   - **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS

3. **[Jobayar Abir Peal (mrpeal • JAP Studios)](https://www.mrpeal.com/)**
   - **Role**: Lead Architect • **Category**: Cinematic Portfolio
   - **Description**: Official portfolio and cinematic showcase for award-nominated Film Director & Lead Editor Jobayar Abir Peal (Chief Editor behind blockbuster films Toofan, Surongo, and Mohanagar 2).
   - **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS

4. **[AGT Software Partners](https://allgentech.io/)**
   - **Role**: CTO • **Category**: Enterprise Solutions
   - **Description**: Global enterprise technology partner delivering scalable full-stack applications, AI/ML integrations, and dedicated engineering teams to US venture-backed and high-growth companies.
   - **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Node.js

5. **[mushfiqweb.com](https://www.mushfiqweb.com)**
   - **Role**: Creator • **Category**: Open Source
   - **Description**: Personal digital garden, technical blog, and developer portfolio crafted with Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, Contentlayer, and interactive micro-animations.
   - **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TailwindCSS, TypeScript, Drizzle, Umami

## Core Expertise & Background

- **Experience**: Over 15 years of professional full-stack software development and technical leadership.
- **Specializations**: Full-Stack Web Development, eCommerce Systems, Distributed Architectures, Engineering Leadership, Performance Optimization, Cloud Infrastructure.
- **Primary Tech Stack**: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Remix, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, REST APIs, Microservices, Vercel, AWS.
